meta.title: An RFQ and an Auction cannot be created together; max 2 stages at creation

steps.note: Open the multi-stage project creation screen where stage selection is available.
Select RFQ as the initial stage.
Confirm that RFQ is the selected stage before checking incompatible options.
Provide the required event title for this creation flow.
Open the stage selector to inspect which additional stages are allowed.
Assert that Auction cannot be added alongside RFQ while Technical Stage remains available.
Add the permitted second stage to reach the maximum of two stages.
Confirm that exactly the two selected stages are present.
Reopen the selector after two stages have been selected.
Assert that no third stage can be selected once the two-stage limit is reached.
